subject.title: [Feature]: Merge iOS Privacy and Location card state

question: Should iOS Settings > Privacy collapse the Location-derived Privacy summary into the Location card and replace the visible segmented Location picker with Location Sharing plus Access Level controls?
rationale: The duplicate state is source-proven, but the proposed switch/value-row design changes a visible iOS privacy control and should be accepted by the iOS/product owner before landing.

options.title: Approve the narrow card merge
options.body: Use the linked PR direction: remove the standalone Location-derived Privacy card, make Location the single state owner, and require focused tests for the new UI contract.

options.title: Keep the segmented picker for now
options.body: Leave current main unchanged and close or revise the linked PR if maintainers want the existing Off/While Using/Always segmented control preserved.

options.title: Defer to broader location policy work
options.body: Treat this as dependent on the broader Location Always/background-location direction and keep the linked PR paused until that policy settles.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow card merge
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR direction: remove the standalone Location-derived Privacy card, make Location the single state owner, and require focused tests for the new UI contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on the same iOS Privacy settings destination makes this the best available owner for the UX direction call.
